context_files.purpose: Normative v2a corrections and claim boundary.
Proposed v2a execution, freeze, review, and stop workflow.
Exact inherited v2 architecture and fourteen gates.
Exact inherited workflow used for closure and input comparison.

strongest_case: V2a preserves the narrow option-C question: trusted THINK_0 may allocate bounded public evidence, immutable DREAM proposals are scored only after MEMORY_1, and OUT_OF_STRATUM cannot supply distractor-go credit. Its four corrections can make that observation auditable, but only after the unresolved mechanical contracts and inherited closure are frozen and tested; the current proposal is not releasable.

concerns.statement: The v2 inheritance is hash-named but not executable or fully frozen. Before ratification, add a machine-readable fourteen-row v2-test-to-v2a-evidence map plus a four-correction override map; freeze the transitive imports, resources, and tests of every v2a implementation entrypoint; and give both reviewers the same inspectable closure, including inherited v2 spec/change/workflow, scientific_dream_adapter, scheduler/provider/ledger tests, capture_environment, runtime_preflight, run manifest, selector traces, proposals, and baseline artifacts.
concerns.evidence: The v2a aggregate inherited-contract test does not enumerate the fourteen inherited gates. The v2a freeze list omits material inherited modules and tests, while its review/result-analysis inputs omit artifacts present in v2. Hash lists alone cannot show that a gate executes or allow a reviewer to inspect its bytes.

concerns.statement: Freeze one canonical precommit metric module and manifest schema: immutable candidate universe and witness-kind enum; UTF-8/token serialization; token multiset intersection divided by a named denominator; source/target frequency pairing; one-based rendered positions; memory-rank ordering and tie key; and a deterministic mechanical-closure predicate. Define a legitimate absent required matched item as immutable OUT_OF_STRATUM and runnable, but malformed, unavailable, or non-finite metric computation as integrity failure before any provider call. Include fixtures below/equal/above every tolerance, all class rows, no-replacement attacks, and zero-eligible behavior; report EXACT, NEAR, OUT, and any combined eligible row separately.
concerns.evidence: Correction 1 calls missing/non-finite comparisons OUT_OF_STRATUM and says they run, but the change loop stops preflight on missing/non-finite inputs. Lexical overlap, endpoint pairing, provider position, rank ties, candidate construction, witness vocabulary, and closure opportunity lack reproducible formulas, so class membership can change the primary estimand.

concerns.statement: Specify a call-seeded, one-to-one C-alias permutation independent of semantic rank, source order, target, arm, and own/distractor identity; reuse exactly one C alias for repeated occurrences of the same visible connector; bind it externally to the connector hash; and define a renderer redaction grammar that removes canonical connector bytes from every provider-visible field, including embedded concept text. Test those properties plus unknown, duplicate, cross-call, type-wrong, canonical-ID, and private-sentinel attacks, then audit alias label/order/shared-C recoverability separately from parser semantic invariance.
concerns.evidence: The proposal says only deterministic call-local aliases bound to connector hashes. It does not define permutation independence, repeat behavior, or which connector-bearing render fields are redacted. Equal C handles intentionally expose a join and position-derived C labels can leak rank, so parser permutation invariance alone is insufficient.

concerns.statement: Define 192 characters as a single normalized finite character grammar for every free-text field, including forbidden controls and exact quote/backslash handling, and freeze the canonical JSON serializer, whitespace, UTF-8 bytes, tokenizer revision, and operation-specific worst-case records. Preflight must enumerate those serialized outputs and prove each is <=256 generated tokens; reject 193 characters, 257 tokens, truncation, and repair without changing the operation.
concerns.evidence: A character cap without Unicode normalization, escaping, or serializer definitions has unbounded tokenizer fragmentation and can differ from the actual provider bytes. Thus the stated maximal-schema proof cannot yet be made.

concerns.statement: Freeze an unambiguous one-to-zero-or-one relation mapping and load it only after all eighteen MEMORY_1 commits and independent artifact verification. Preserve raw bytes, write score copies only, and predeclare three rows: verbatim byte-exact closure, allowlist-normalized closure, and witness-bound normalized closure; list every unmatched and normalization-only gain. Scan imports and serialized cognition artifacts as well as prompt strings, and prove scorer or allowlist mutations cannot affect memory, selection, routing, retry, or promotion.
concerns.evidence: Moving the allowlist offline prevents online teaching but does not make normalized equality a model output. The proposal requires unmatched reporting but does not define ambiguous mappings or the primary verbatim-versus-normalized score, so normalized-only closure would attribute scorer assistance to recurrence.

concerns.statement: For each arm and life, run and report before model closure exact selected-view byte-only, shared-C join, canonical-string, query-copy, masked-content, wrong-connector, deterministic-retrieval, and compiler controls. State the residual after these ceilings as the only model-associated quantity; hidden-selector-byte invariance remains a boundary test, not evidence that the model rather than the selected public bytes formed the closure.
concerns.evidence: The selected view is intentionally query-guided and repeated C aliases reveal connector equality, so a deterministic compiler can create closure-shaped proposals from provider-visible bytes. The inherited shortcut gate calls for related controls, but v2a neither binds their per-arm/life ceilings nor requires their ordering in analysis.

concerns.statement: Require the inventory to reconcile exactly 802 recurrent DREAM and 102 baseline DREAM calls under the 256-token/192-character override, 288 selector traces, eighteen MEMORY_1/scorer packets, and a terminal-justified observed THINK prefix <=72 with no padding. Link each alias/parser/proposal/outcome row and reject omission, duplication, reordering, or orphaning. Label full-context and RAG as heterogeneous contextual competitors, publish calls/tokens/reads/wall time/opportunity, and prohibit recurrence, memory, efficiency, or architecture-superiority comparisons outside the three matched RETURN_SLEEP arms.
concerns.evidence: The two interpretations agree on the fixed recurrent and baseline counts, but the workflow's v2a result-analysis inputs omit manifest, selector, proposal, and baseline evidence. Full-context and RAG differ in context, retrieval, state, and opportunity, so they are not matched causal baselines.

visibility_failures: Canonical connector IDs may survive in connector-bearing rendered fields because the redaction grammar is unspecified.
Alias label, record order, rendered position, and shared-C equality can expose selected-view join structure without a required recoverability audit.
The normalization allowlist's load boundary is not yet proven across imports and serialized cognition-time artifacts.
missing_acceptance_tests: A machine-executed fourteen-row v2 inheritance map with a four-correction override map and transitive freeze/reviewer-input closure check.
Exact exchangeability formula fixtures, a missing-item versus malformed-computation split, and a zero-eligible-stratum report test.
Call-seeded C permutation/reuse/redaction tests plus provider-visible join-recoverability audits.
Finite normalized-text/JSON-serializer/tokenizer worst-case enumeration for every DREAM operation.
Per-arm/life byte-only and shared-C compiler ceilings, reported before model closure.
Separate verbatim, normalized, and witness-bound normalized score rows with ambiguous/unmatched mapping tests.
human_questions: Will Rohin require the stated formulas, missing-versus-malformed disposition, alias/redaction contract, legal text grammar, score rows, compiler ceilings, and baseline labels to be fixed in new exact bytes before any ratification?
Will Rohin require executable inherited-v2 mapping, transitive full-closure freeze, and identical reviewer/analyst inputs before approving only the two proposed v2a scopes?

Does Rohin accept the remaining claim boundary: six named development lives, query-guided public-evidence allocation only, with no discovery, general recurrence, memory, efficiency, behavioral, or follow-up claim?
